d.seg: कोई बात नहीं आप इंस्टाग्राम पे आ सकते हो मेरे नाम क्या है इंस्टाग्राम
d.tr: No problem, can you come on Instagram? What is your Instagram name?
d.ctx: The user asks the expert to move to Instagram. The expert initially refuses.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (Instagram).

d.seg: मैं बोल रहा हूँ ना किसी चीज़ का कमी नहीं होगा आपकी तो आ जाओ ना इंस्टा पे आ जाओ वहीं बात करेंगे
d.tr: I am telling you, you won't lack anything, so come on Insta, we will talk there.
d.ctx: The user continues to pressure the expert to move to Instagram after the expert expressed hesitation.
d.j: The user is actively proposing to move the conversation to an external app (Instagram).

d.seg: प्रिया राज प्रिया राज डबल एट डबल जीरो
d.tr: Priya Raj Priya Raj double eight double zero
d.ctx: The user provides their Instagram handle/ID to the expert.
d.j: The user is providing an external social media handle to move the conversation off-platform.
